mods.name: Genius Loci
mods.description:
Every place has a character. A desert runs hot and dry, a ravine runs hollow, an ancient city runs cursed and dark. Genius Loci gives you the means to see that character, gather it, and carry it home.

Essence is not mined and nothing drops it. You go and find it: plant a crystal in the heart of a place, tune a second one to it, and walk home with the far end of the line in your pocket. What arrives is a live current rather than a stockpile. Nothing is banked, so a thin supply makes your work slow rather than making it fail, and the only way to go faster is to have been further.

Spend it at a ritual circle you build yourself out of whatever you like. There is no altar block and no machine: set an ingredient on a glass plate to name what you want, put your sword or your bottle of water in the middle, and pulse redstone. Potions, enchantments, repairs and smelting, all of them chosen rather than gambled for, and none of them costing you a single level of experience.

Twelve concepts, twenty-four essences, and every recipe composed from them rather than looked up. Designed as a counterweight to automation mods like Create: where they reward settling in, this rewards going out.

releases.notes:
This release simply fixes one mechanic that was not very intuitive, and introduces a new interface for third party mods to use.

- Mending a worn tool would take the same time, whether it was a slightly-damaged wooden pickaxe, or a heavily-damaged netherite one.  This has been changed so that the amount of essence required to fix the tool now depends on the amount of durability points needed for repaired.  Base time (the 6-mote-per-minute default) is based on the full durability of the iron pickaxe.
- This allows add-on mod authors to scale essence prices for workings based on specific measures (such as item durability).

releases.notes:
Beta 18: Released 2026-10-07

- Sculk sensors now detect the placement, tuning, and removal of cages, foci, and membranes.
- The field guide now counts as a book, for the purposes of the chiseled bookcase.
- Removed the cauldron as the symbol of dilution (reverting one spell level); it would better fit dyeing if an addon author chooses to use it.  The milk bucket is now the primary symbol of dilution.
- The chime when interacting with cages, membranes, and foci are now equally loud.
- All blocks in the core mod (except for the ley cages) use the same API calls that are available for add-ons.
- A mod can add its own blocks to the chunk's reading, counting the blocks of a tag it names, and never touching what the world made.  Think "custom blocks count toward essence," and "thaumcraft taint."

readmeSummary: Welcome to Genius Loci: a flow-based, fully data-driven magic system that treats the Minecraft world itself as your greatest resource.
